title: Co-op Attendance Reliability
dataSources: Game sessions (`game:session`), ranked matches (`ranked:match`), co-op invites (`coop:session`), speedrun attempts (`speedrun:attempt`), server events (`server:event`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), raid attempts (`raid:attempt`), and daily quest logs (`quest:completion`).
app: Gaming telemetry from platform session APIs, ranked-match exports, co-op schedulers, speedrun splits, server logs, raid trackers, and board-game play records streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=coop:session
| stats sum(eval(if(attended=1,1,0))) as attended_sessions count as invited_sessions by squad
| eval attendance_pct=round(100*attended_sessions/invited_sessions,1)
description: Calculates how often each co-op squad actually makes the sessions it scheduled.
value: Reliable attendance keeps social play healthy, and a simple percentage is enough to see which groups are solid.
implementation: Log invites and actual attendance from a co-op scheduling tool, chat bot, or calendar export.
visualization: Bar chart of co-op attendance percentage by squad.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which gaming groups really show up when they say they will.
